text: REST-based API v2 to programmatically book meetings and read/write scheduling, contacts, and notetaker data
quote: Programmatically book meetings and read and write Scheduling, Contacts, and Notetaker data.

text: Official Calendly MCP server exposes scheduling tools to AI apps, each mapped to an equivalent REST endpoint
quote: Below is the complete list of tools exposed by the Calendly MCP server, organized by category with the equivalent REST endpoint for each.

text: Natural-language commands are translated into structured Calendly API calls without writing raw REST requests
quote: It translates natural-language commands (e.g., "Book a 30-minute meeting with Sam next Tuesday") into structured Calendly API calls with no need to implement raw REST requests.

text: AI assistants or agents in your product can book meetings end-to-end via the Scheduling API, without redirecting users to Calendly
quote: Enable AI assistants or agents in your product to **book meetings end‑to‑end** via Calendly's Scheduling API endpoint.

text: MCP uses Dynamic Client Registration so no pre-registered OAuth application is needed
quote: Calendly MCP uses Dynamic Client Registration (DCR), which means **you do not need to pre-register an OAuth application**

text: Personal access tokens authenticate internal or private applications
quote: Use a personal access token to authenticate an internal or private application with the Calendly API v2.

text: OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE lets public apps access data on behalf of other Calendly users
quote: Create an OAuth app to access Calendly data on behalf of other Calendly users. Then use the OAuth authorization code flow with PKCE to get an access token for each user.

text: OAuth scopes control which Calendly resources an integration can read or modify
quote: Scopes control which Calendly resources your integration can read or modify.

text: Sandbox environment is available for development and testing, separate from production
quote: select **Sandbox** for development and testing, or **Production** when your app is ready for real users.

text: API access is available on any subscription plan, including Free
quote: Developers can make GET and POST requests to API endpoints on behalf of a Calendly user on any subscription plan, including the Free plan

text: Webhooks deliver real-time payloads when invitees schedule, cancel, or reschedule meetings
quote: Webhook API: Our friendly, lightweight API that lets you automatically receive Calendly data with webhook subscriptions anytime invitees schedule, cancel, or reschedule a meeting.

text: Subscribe to scheduling, contacts, and notetaker events to trigger automations as they happen
quote: Subscribe to Scheduling, Contacts, and Notetaker events to run automations the moment they happen.

text: A reschedule fires both invitee.created and invitee.canceled webhook events

text: Webhook signing keys verify that webhook payloads are authentic
quote: Gain confidence in the authenticity of your webhooks when you use a **webhook signing key**, a unique secret key shared between your application and Calendly, to verify the events sent to your endpoints.

text: Failed webhook deliveries are retried for 24 hours with exponential back-off
quote: it will continue to try to deliver for 24 hours with an exponential back-off that makes attempts less and less frequently

text: Webhook subscriptions can be created for an organization, user, or group
quote: Create a Webhook Subscription for an Organization, User, or Group.

text: Webhook subscriptions can be listed and deleted via the API
quote: DELETE https://api.calendly.com/webhook_subscriptions/{webhook_uuid} Delete a Webhook Subscription.

text: Sample webhook data endpoint lets you test a webhook subscription
quote: GET https://api.calendly.com/sample_webhook_data Test your webhook subscription

text: A webhook event fires whenever a routing form is submitted, whether or not the person books
quote: Subscribing to the **`routing_form_submission.created`** event will fire anytime someone submits a routing form, whether they book or not.

text: Embed a scheduling page in your site or app as inline, popup, or button trigger, using an HTML snippet

quote: To initilize an **inline** embed, use `Calendly.initInlineWidget({url: myLink});`

text: API retrieves available times for a specific event type, up to 31 days per request
